messages:
rachel-devex: Customer flagged a break in our onboarding samples after 5.1.0. They run Bun + Cloudflare Workers and see: 

rachel-devex: `Error: The requested module "@redwood/sdk" does not provide an export named "default"`

sambuild: That usually means the ESM entry lacks a default export while their code does `import SDK from '@redwood/sdk'`. Which exports map did we publish?

rachel-devex: We tightened the exports map and added conditional subpaths for types. package.json snippet: 

rachel-devex: ```json
rachel-devex: "exports": {
rachel-devex:   ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" },
rachel-devex:   "./internal/*": "./dist/internal/*.js",
rachel-devex:   "./package.json": "./package.json"
rachel-devex: }
rachel-devex: ```

ivan-runtime: Two red flags: 1) We exposed internal wildcard `./internal/*` which leaks private files to some bundlers; 2) some edge bundlers (Bun / Workers) don't honor the `types` conditional inside exports, so TS resolution falls back and fails. Also, default imports are brittle if ESM doesn't export default.

priya-qa: Repro I ran: onboarding-sample with `import SDK from '@redwood/sdk'` + `bun dev` -> immediate error. Replacing with `import * as SDK from '@redwood/sdk'` still breaks for runtime code expecting a callable default. TS in CI shows: `Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/sdk'.`

sambuild: Short term: publish a patch that does 3 things: 1) Add a default ESM shim: in dist/index.mjs `export { createClient as default } from './client.js'` so old default-import consumers remain working. 2) Add a top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts" in package.json because many toolchains ignore conditional types under exports. 3) Remove the `./internal/*` wildcard and instead add explicit subpaths for any public deep imports we want to support (e.g., `"./legacy": "./dist/legacy.mjs"`).

ivan-runtime: Agree. Also add a lint check in our publish step to detect wildcards that point into dist/internal. That prevented accidental exposure of private modules in the past.

priya-qa: I'll add Bun + Workers smoke runs to sample-apps CI and a step that installs the published tarball and runs `tsc --noEmit` against the sample to validate types resolution. We should catch this before cutting a release.

typings-bot: Typings check: current build emits dist/index.d.ts but some consumers need the package-level "types" field to locate it. Adding that field will resolve TS7016 in many setups.

zara-docs: We also need a short migration note in the SDK changelog and the onboarding repo: state that default imports are deprecated and encourage `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'`, but we'll ship a compat shim for one patch cycle. Also mention not to depend on deep internal paths; we'll publish a deprecation timeline for any public deep subpaths.

rachel-devex: I'll open a draft PR for a 5.1.1 patch with the default shim + top-level types + explicit `./legacy` subpath, and ping @sambuild and @ivan-runtime for review. We'll notify support and update onboarding samples after release.

sambuild: Once PR is green, cut patch and add automated smoke test to the release checklist.

ivan-runtime: For long term, add an export-map validator in CI and a small compatibility test matrix (Node/esbuild, Bun, Cloudflare Workers) that runs against the built package before publish. That should reduce regressions like this.

rachel-devex: Thanks all — I'll coordinate the release and customer communication.
